name_en: the byword for marbling, from virgin heifers only
summary_ja: 未経産の雌牛だけを長期肥育する。霜降りの代名詞として「肉の芸術品」と呼ばれる。
summary_en: Only virgin heifers, fattened long — the byword for marbling, called “a work of art in meat.”

name_en: a title only the best Tajima cattle may bear
summary_ja: 但馬牛のうち、霜降りなどの厳格な基準を満たした肉だけが名乗れる称号。
summary_en: A title, not a herd: only Tajima cattle meeting strict marbling standards may bear the name.

summary_ja: 日本最古級の食用牛ブランド。彦根藩が味噌漬けにして将軍家へ献上した歴史を持つ。
summary_en: Among Japan's oldest beef brands — the Hikone domain once presented it miso-cured to the shogun.

name_en: made famous by an English teacher in early Meiji
summary_ja: 明治初期、招かれた英国人教師が味を伝えて広まったとされる。寒暖差の大きい置賜盆地で育つ。
summary_en: Said to have been made famous by an English teacher in early Meiji. Raised in the Okitama basin's sharp seasons.

name_en: built on the line of a single famed sire
summary_ja: 一頭の名種雄牛「安福号」の系統が礎を築いた。飛騨の山あいで育つ。
summary_en: Built on the line of a single famed sire, Yasufuku — raised in the Hida mountains.

name_en: the root stock behind Kobe Beef and others
summary_ja: 神戸ビーフをはじめ多くの銘柄の素となる系統。谷ごとに血統が守られてきた。
summary_en: The root stock behind Kobe Beef and many other brands, its bloodlines long kept valley by valley.

summary_ja: 全国和牛能力共進会で最高賞を重ねてきた、県を挙げて育てる銘柄。
summary_en: A prefecture-wide brand that has repeatedly taken the top prize at Japan's national wagyu exhibition.

summary_ja: 北上川沿いの前沢で育つ、東北を代表する霜降りの銘柄。
summary_en: Raised in Maesawa along the Kitakami river — Tohoku's flagship marbled beef.

summary_ja: 肉質等級が最高の「5」でなければ名乗れない、基準の最も厳しい銘柄のひとつ。
summary_en: One of the strictest brands: only carcasses graded a full 5 for quality may carry the name.

summary_ja: きめ細かな霜降りを基準に選ばれる、九州を代表する銘柄のひとつ。
summary_en: One of Kyushu's leading brands, selected on fine-grained marbling standards.
